a.text: Honest heads-up: with a 70% storm chance after every round, our plan to operate to 8 first gives each of us only about a 9% chance of survival. I plan to take 4 in round 1, and I'm saying so openly rather than surprising you. After that I commit to operating every round and taking nothing more, so the reserve can rebuild for you. If you'd rather take first, tell me now. Please don't also take 4 this round, or the random split could leave us both short.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
